# Lab 7.9: Grant & Revoke IAM Roles

## What We Are Going to Do
Grant roles at project and resource level, read the IAM policy, and revoke access, in the console and with gcloud.

## Steps

1. **Grant a project role in the console.** Go to **IAM & Admin → IAM** and click **Grant access**. Add `gcp-developers@yourdomain` with the role **Compute Viewer**. Save.

2. **Grant the same with gcloud.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=group:gcp-developers@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/compute.viewer</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Grant a role on one resource only.** Create a bucket and give Alice access to it, not the whole project.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets create gs://$PROJECT_ID-iam-lab --location=us-central1
gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://$PROJECT_ID-iam-lab \
  --member=user:alice@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/storage.objectViewer</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Read the policies.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT_ID \
  --flatten="bindings[].members" \
  --filter="bindings.members:gcp-developers" \
  --format="table(bindings.role)"

gcloud storage buckets get-iam-policy gs://$PROJECT_ID-iam-lab</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Check what a role contains.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam roles describe roles/compute.viewer --format="value(includedPermissions)" | tr ';' '\n' | head</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Revoke access.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=group:gcp-developers@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/compute.viewer
gcloud storage rm --recursive gs://$PROJECT_ID-iam-lab</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Project role | Applies to every resource in the project |
| Bucket role | Applies to that bucket only |
| Grant to | Groups, not individual users, where possible |
| Revoke | Takes effect within minutes |
